default.description: The trusted cockpit WEBVIEW, and only it, may bind the frame stream, submit human-control intents, acknowledge frames and take interaction holds. It is granted no core permission at all: the frame stream is a Channel the frontend constructs and hands over, so nothing here needs the event system — and core:default, which W.2 granted, carries core:event:default, whose emit and emit-to are the ability to inject into the application's own event bus. W.2.1 said `windows` here, which grants every webview inside that window: tauri's resolver is an OR over the two lists (`ipc/authority.rs`, resolve_access), so a pane hosted INSIDE the cockpit window would have inherited all of this. A browser or application pane is going to be exactly that, so the grant is to the webview label and the window list is empty.
